newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cabinet mulls CZK 30bln in budget cuts - paper.
newsitem.headline: Czech cabinet mulls CZK 30bln in budget cuts - paper.

text.p: The Czech government is considering a plan to cut 30 billion crowns in state spending in order to stem a growing budget deficit, the daily Mlada Fronta Dnes said on Wednesday, quoting unnamed senior ministers.
It quoted two members of the cabinet as saying the plan under consideration included a two to three month delay in an increase in pensions planned for July.
